EFI SYSTEM — Troubleshooting with Volt/Ohmmeter (7M-GTE)                    FI-63

No. | Terminals | Trouble | Condition | STD Voltage
8   | IGT — E1  | No voltage | Idling | 0.7 — 1.0 V

[DIAGRAM: Circuit diagram showing Battery, MAIN 2.0L Fusible Link, AM2 30A, Ignition Switch with AM2 and IG2, ECU with connections to Tachometer, Igniter, IGF, IGT, and E1, with ground connections]

FI0814

[DIAGRAM 1: ECU connector diagram showing Voltmeter connected to IGT and E1 terminals]

1. There is no voltage between ECU terminals IGT and E1. (Idling)

2. Check that there is voltage between ECU terminal IGT and body ground. (Idling)

NO | OK

3. Check wiring between ECU terminal E1 and body ground. | BAD | Repair or replace.

OK

Try another ECU.
